verdicts.note: Signal red is not a documented UR code (art.json says black and hazard yellow). Confirm with the collective or drop the red claim.

summary: The dossiers hold up on the verified facts (60-22, No. 1 seed, 125-94 Game 7 loss to Cleveland, Duren's $200M, Oct 20 Boston opener, Cup Group A, MLK Day at Cleveland, no Christmas game, Specter) with one real contradiction: rhythm put Game 7 at Cleveland when the top seed hosted it. Most errors were smaller local facts: Carhartt's founding city, Polish Village Cafe's street, the Burn Rubber location (Royal Oak, with Detroit sister store Two18), the Bad Boys and teal-era color palettes, and the claim that the slogan 'Detroit vs. Everybody' began as a 2016 song. Unsupported or unconfirmable items (Taqueria El Rey, New Dodge Lounge, Takashi Yagihashi, a recurring City Edition pattern, Sada Baby's Pistons tie) were removed or softened. Live checks found Hockeytown Cafe apparently operating, Lafayette Coney Island repeatedly closed for health violations in 2022 and 2025, and Burn Rubber's status unconfirmed. The strategy brief needs edits on Carhartt, Burn Rubber/Two18, the Signal Red techno claim, the City Edition avoid line and the ambassador names, and the Pewabic partnership and the Great Lakes Crossing Nike store remain the biggest unverified dependencies.
